mentions.name: Fetch
mentions.description: Fetch is a native macOS client for ClickHouse, built in Swift/SwiftUI with Monaco as the SQL editor. It aims to make querying ClickHouse feel like using a polished desktop app with ClickHouse native features.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on "Fetch", a native macOS client for ClickHouse.

The idea is to make querying ClickHouse feel more like using a polished desktop with ClickHouse native features :

It’s built in Swift/SwiftUI with Monaco as the SQL editor.
